import { turbine } from './generated/turbine/index.js';
export async function generated(url:string){
  const db=await turbine(url);
  try{
    const rows=await db.mailProjection.findMany({where:{tenant:'B',consumer:'mail'},select:{delivered:true},limit:1});
    const n:number|undefined=rows[0]?.delivered;
    if(n!==2)throw new Error('Generated native projection mismatch');
    if(false){
      // @ts-expect-error Generated columns reject unknown names.
      await db.mailProjection.findMany({select:{missing:true}});
      // @ts-expect-error Generated int field filters reject text.
      await db.mailProjection.findMany({where:{delivered:'wrong'}});
    }
  }finally{await db.disconnect();}
}
await generated(process.env.MYSQL_URL!);
